speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are still treating the hand-over as a manual checkpoint, but I need that feature store link to fire automatically the moment the nightly scan lines land. I am not asking for a bigger meeting, I am asking for the pipeline to stop waiting on a human to click run.
output.correction: I never said we should skip the data quality checks, I said the trigger for the training run must be automated to keep the data fresh. You filed this as a governance gap, but my point was purely about the automation level of that hand-over step.
